why:
Measured against the recorded upstream surfaces (`docs/reference/api-surface/{rclc,rclcpp,rclrs}.json`): none of them contains `park`, `wake_source`, `spin_nominal` or `granularity` at all, so there is no upstream name to align to. Same basis as the `Executor::release_jitter` pair beside it.

phase-436. What the release-jitter number is WORTH, reported rather than applied — silently coarsening a bound could mask real lateness. A declared cadence (`set_spin_nominal_us`) is paced by the caller, as nros-cpp's tiers are with `platform_sleep_us` between spins, and that sleep is finer than the wait, so the measurement really is good to a microsecond and coarsening it would understate it.
